in_marathi.name: Ajaypal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajaypal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajaypal is a combination of two Sanskrit words, ‘Aj’ meaning invincible or unconquerable and ‘Pal’ meaning lotus. This name is given to a child born into a royal or powerful family, symbolizing their strength and power.
